references.text: Kadesh-Barnea is mentioned as the starting point for the spies sent into Canaan
The Lord's oath that the entire generation of warriors would die in the wilderness because of their rebellion
The Lord's anger and the forty years in the wilderness until the whole generation that had done evil was gone
The journey from Horeb to Kadesh-Barnea took eleven days, but Israel wandered for 38 years
The Lord's oath that none of that evil generation would see the good land
Israel wandered in the wilderness for forty years until all the warriors who left Egypt had died
The Lord's anger toward the generation in the wilderness and his oath that they would not enter into his rest
A reference to those who sinned and whose bodies fell in the wilderness, and who were not allowed to enter because of unbelief
